race.comment: MUKATILA (10) is back after a 31-week spell which following a promising maiden campaign. Best efforts were consecutive placings over slightly longer trips at Swan Hill and Kilmore. Should be ready to make a positive return against an ordinary field on the back of three recent trials. NIGHT MEETING (2) settled near the tail of the field then stoked up late to finish fifth last time out over this course and distance when fresh from a 29-week lay-off. Has only raced twice so there is plenty of upside - worth following. SANDZIBAR (5) has transferred to the Paul McVicar yard and is back after an 81-day absence. Ran an eye-catching fourth over 1000m at Warracknabeal to kick off last prep. Will get back from a wide alley but is one to watch for late in the piece. BAMBU BABE (8) passed a pre-race vet's check but ran a shocker at Echuca last start when fresh from a 38-day let-up. Deserves the benefit of the doubt with that run now under the belt. A gap to TYPHOON ROMANCE (11) who can improve.
